verdict.rationale: Portkey documents integration via REST API with base URL/headers and compatibility with OpenAI's Python/Node SDKs, plus an open-source gateway (npx install), implying official SDK-style usage, but no evidence pack citation explicitly names a dedicated Portkey-branded SDK (e.g., portkey-ai Python/Node package) with API reference or independent corroboration. missing for 10: explicit mention/documentation of official Portkey SDK packages (Python/Node) beyond OpenAI-SDK-compatibility, an OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s), and independent/hands-on confirmation of SDK usage.
